items.reason: Boonta Eve Flagbearer has no Action and no ready-related text; its only text is "When a friendly unit attacks: If no other units have attacked this phase... heal 2 damage from your base." Readying Eravana's Beast token gives Boonta nothing, so wants:ready-unit is unsupported.
Synara San's text is "On Attack: For each friendly unit, ready a friendly resource." It readies resources, not units, and has no Action to re-use, so it does not want a ready unit.

One in a Million's only offered effect is "Defeat a unit with power and remaining HP both equal to the number of ready resources you control," which does not say friendly, so the defeated unit may be an enemy's and never reaches your discard. The only discard it causes is its own resolution, which the offers tags do not record.
Leia Organa has the printed trait Official, and Mon Mothma's deployBox says "Each other friendly Official unit gets +0/+1," which references the Official trait.
Hotshot Maneuver says "Then, attack with the chosen unit," so a chosen Rose Tico attacks again, and her deployBox "On Attack: You may heal 2 damage from a Vehicle unit" fires again.
Cad Bane's Action "Deal 1 damage to a unit with 2 or more remaining HP" can target a friendly unit, and Arena Nexu has Grit, which gives +1/+0 for each damage on it.

Queen Amidala's defeat is "defeat another friendly unit that shares a trait with this unit" (Naboo or Official), and it only happens if damage would be dealt to her. Old Daka needs a friendly Night unit, and the Spy tokens she creates are not Night, so the offered defeat does not reliably put a Night unit in the discard.

Cat and Mouse says "ready a friendly unit in the same arena with power equal to or less than that enemy unit," which can ready Jyn Erso (power 3) after she exhausts. Jyn's "Action [1 resource, Exhaust]" is then usable again.
8D8's Action is "Deal 1 damage to another friendly unit," and Quarren Contractor has Grit, which "gets +1/+0 for each damage on it."
Skyway Cloud Car's When Defeated only returns "a non-leader unit with 2 or less power." Han Solo has 3 power, so Skyway cannot return him and cannot offer the replay of Han's When Played.
Death Field says "If you control a Force unit, draw a card," and Dooku has the printed trait Force.
Howl says "You may return a non-leader unit to its owner's hand," which can return your own U-Wing Lander, whose "When Played: Give 3 Experience tokens to this unit" then replays.

Insurgent Camp readies a unit only when "you play a unit with 3 or less power," which is the unit's entry, before it has attacked. Bodhi Rook has no Action, so that ready neither re-uses an ability nor grants a second On Attack, and wants:ready-unit is unsupported.

Ima-Gun Di's When Defeated says "you may resource a card from your hand," which needs a card in hand but does not count hand size. The cards-in-hand tag is curated (cur-0176) rather than drawn from its text, so the hand-size reason does not describe this card.
Ataru Onslaught says "Ready a Force unit with 4 or less power," and Zuckuss has the printed trait Force and power 4.

Rebellious Hammerhead says "You may deal damage to a unit equal to the number of cards in your hand," which can damage a friendly unit. Heroic ARC-170's "If you control a damaged unit, you may deal 2 damage to an enemy unit" then sees that damage.
Sly Moore's deployBox says "On Attack: You may deal 2 damage to an exhausted unit," which can make a ground unit damaged, and AT-DP Occupier costs 1 less "for each damaged ground unit."

Gorian Shard's Corsair says "When Played/On Attack: You may deal 2 damage to a unit," which can damage a non-leader unit, and Charged with Murder then defeats "a damaged non-leader unit" (after a Vigilance disclose).

Dedra Meero's Action says "Choose an enemy unit. Its controller may deal 2 damage to it," so the damage comes from the opponent, never from you to your own unit. The offers tag damage-any-unit does not record that, and Echo Base Engineer needs a damaged unit that you damage yourself.
Academy Disciplinarian readies only "a friendly unit with 2 or less power." Asajj Ventress has 4 power, so Disciplinarian cannot ready her and cannot re-use her "Action [Exhaust]".
Umbaran Mobile Cannon has the printed trait Vehicle, and Supremacy says "Other friendly Vehicle units get +6/+6," which references the Vehicle trait.
Log Trap says "Attack with a friendly unit. Then attack with it again," so a chosen Vice Admiral Rampart fires her On Attack again on the second attack.
Hunter's Instinct is an Upgrade, and Gar Saxon says "When you play an upgrade on this unit: You may create a Mandalorian token," so attaching it to Gar Saxon triggers his ability.

Face Off says "you may ready an enemy unit. If you do, ready a friendly unit in the same arena," which can ready the unit carrying Adventurer Sniper Rifle, whose granted "Action [Exhaust]" then fires again.
Grogu says "When you take the initiative: You may attack with a unit," which can attack with Darth Traya, and her "On Attack: You may ready a non-unit leader" then fires again.
